scope: MEAS: independent gates/report, source metadata, all current overlays, complete two-page public sheet, actual staged-public SVG/index equivalence and listen review; not aural review.

defects.evidence: The actual engraved key is nominal G minor, while the public repeats field identifies the A-minor source and the public source.edition/method do not state the whole-score -2-semitone adaptation. The config and report, unlike the published score metadata, disclose it and the additional vocal octave convention.
defects.fix: Add the whole-score -2 semitones / nominal G-minor engraving and vocal sounding octave convention to public source.edition or repeats, preserving the explicit distinction between transfer-relative measured pitch and the historically uncertain performed key. Republish through the driver; do not change source notes or infer a historical key.

defects.evidence: Listen sections[2] and transition interlude-to-verse-three.at are at 80 s, although both name entry into verses 3-4. Actual printed bar 31 begins at 92.268 s and contains the start of stanza 3; the preceding four bars 27-30 are the piano-only interlude already identified in the t90 cue.
defects.fix: Move that section and transition entry to approximately 92.3 s or an explicitly supported bar-31 reference. Keep the interlude as an interlude and update timing evidence; do not use its start as the sung verse-3 boundary. Have the listen owner check dependent prose for the same distinction.

report.finding: Current report agrees with recomputed metrics, 563 notes / five encoded voices, 61-bar once-through order, two-page / 600-glyph actual pack and source provenance. It correctly explains initial-grace common origin, G-minor transfer-relative notation, vocal octave convention, noisy decay and no aural review.

barMap.finding: All 563 note voice/bar indices resolve, durations are positive and bar times strictly increase. Both complete public pages inspected. Exactly three initial staves with correctly placed key/time signatures and visible vocal-octave disclosure; no floating setup row. Actual public index equals the inspected stage; both SVG trees are identical after only consistent DOM-prefix normalization. Printed bars 1-61 match score and index; no invented repeated strophes.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified. Baritone contour and piano drone are consistent with the configured sounding registers; first grace at 1.28 s is not confused with earlier noise. Final attack 188.598310 s and pitched hold ending 191.76 s precede the file/noise end. Primary onset omissions in quiet windows and the large P95 remain disclosed; numeric pass is not every-note validation.

source.edition: OpenScore Lieder later-version transcription, original A-minor source; its identified scan is IMSLP60822, whose printed imprint is not independently established here.

version.finding: Voice and piano, all five stanzas written out across bars 1-61 once, with original two piano staves and German lyrics. No gross cut/arrangement mismatch identified. Source-encoded voices are not separated audio stems; the measured transfer-relative pitch adaptation is not proof of a historically selected key or physical performing edition.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration run by VerS. Complete pages were raster-inspected and their vector contents compared. Warped source durations, including the final hold, do not measure physical releases. EXT: The underlying IMSLP60822 printed score was not opened in this review; no imprint or scan-note claims are taken from it.
